title: sneed-and-feed/lean-theorems-1
summary: A complete machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem (1961) on intersecting families of finite sets using Katona's circle method (1972), along with the construction of the classical Hilton–Milner (1967) extremal non-star intersecting family. To the maintainers' knowledge, the theorem was not found in an exact declaration, docstring, and type signature search of the pinned Mathlib revision (Mathlib v4.34.0-rc1).
